name: arcosian-unity
description: Unity adapter for arcosian: a Unity-aware C# language server for Claude Code (csharp-ls on the Editor's project files, or on the engine-free assemblies when Unity has not written them), the official Unity CLI (unity mcp / command / eval), CoplayDev unity-mcp notes, and a skill on editor control, tests, play mode, screenshots, builds and the SceneBuilder pattern.
